items.title: 6.3 Billion Reasons This Top Automaker Is Changing the Game
items.summary: General Motors is showing how lucrative digital services can be and how much potential it has with its growth and retention rates -- and Ford Motor Company has similar potential.

items.title: Ford Just Put Apple Maps in the Dashboard of a $30,000 EV. Apple Didn't Have to Build a Car.

items.summary: Archer burns cash fast but has FAA certification hurdles ahead; Ford bleeds billions despite $174 billion in revenue.

items.title: Ford Teams Up With a Chinese Auto Maker. Is It a Good Deal?
